source.name: Emirates media centre - Emirates signs on as global partner and exclusive airline partner of SailGP
source.note: Five-season global sponsorship from Nov 2024; Emirates is Title Partner of the Emirates Great Britain SailGP Team and its Portsmouth home event. The club's 'Title Partner' listing and the team name were re-confirmed on the club site and sailgp.com team page on 2026-09-30.
source.quote: Emirates is also a proud sponsor of Emirates Great Britain SailGP Team, one of the league’s most successful sailing teams.

source.name: Howden: Howden strengthens partnership with Emirates GBR SailGP Team as Tier 2 Global Partner
source.quote: Howden today announces the elevation of its partnership with the Emirates Great Britain SailGP Team (“Emirates GBR”) to Tier 2 Global Partner

source.name: J.P. Morgan Private Bank: Emirates GBR partnership page (undated, read 30 September 2026)
source.note: J.P. Morgan's own page on its global partnership with the team; the sailgp.com team page also lists 'JP Morgan' among the Emirates GBR Global Partners (checked 2026-09-30).
source.quote: A proud partnership with the 2025 SailGP champions - Emirates Great Britain Team

source.name: Jumeirah media hub: Jumeirah Joins Emirates Great Britain SailGP Team As Global Partner
source.quote: Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, is proud to announce a three-season global partnership with the Emirates Great Britan SailGP Team

source.name: EQT: EQT enters global partnership with Emirates Great Britain SailGP Team
source.quote: As part of the partnership with the Emirates GBR, EQT becomes the sailing team’s official private markets partner across all global SailGP championship events through 2030.

summary: Dubai's state airline owns the name on Britain's boat: Emirates is Title Partner of the defending champions.
